$comment: The host shell. Everything here is built once and is identical in every area. The shell is not a menu of areas — see rules below.

rules.rule: At most two programs may be active at once.
rules.why: Three concurrent behaviour changes is where adherence collapses. A third requires a conversation with a clinician or coach, not a tap.

rules.rule: The home screen shows active programs only. The eleven areas are never listed there.
rules.why: A directory leaks what a person is dealing with to anyone who picks up the phone, and turns a product into a menu.

rules.rule: One global crisis route, identical from every screen in every program.
rules.why: Per-program crisis copy will be wrong in at least one program. One route, reviewed once, reachable everywhere.

rules.rule: Sharing consent is granted per program, never globally.
rules.why: A cessation coach has no business seeing behavioural health data. Under 42 CFR Part 2, substance-use data must be segregated regardless.

rules.rule: Any program can be hidden from the home screen and reached only from Your programs.
rules.why: Stigma is a real adherence barrier on shared or family devices.

rules.rule: Areas whose measures carry clinicalThresholds must be feature-flagged for independent removal.
rules.why: Regulatory classification follows the riskiest feature in the binary. Glucose and blood-pressure routing can drag the whole app toward medical-device territory.

rules.rule: Some service lines never become consumer screens.
rules.why: These belong on a care-team surface with a clinician in the loop.

screens.name: Your programs
screens.purpose: What you are in, what is paused, and one way to add another.

screens.name: Health areas
screens.purpose: The eleven areas, honest about status. Reached on request, never on the home screen.

screens.name: Join a program
screens.purpose: What changes if you join, what is shared, and what it is not.

screens.name: Your record
screens.purpose: One place across every program. Exportable and deletable by the person it describes.

screens.name: Who sees what
screens.purpose: Per-program sharing, shown side by side so the differences are visible.

screens.name: Get help now
screens.purpose: The global crisis route. Identical everywhere, never reordered or filtered.
